summary: Biomedical PhD umbrella offering research rotations before selection among 11 participating programs.

english.toefl: 5.0 on or after January21,2026; 90 iBT earlier; 577 paper
english.note: PTE Academic61 also accepted. Scores valid two years. TOEFL Home Edition accepted; Duolingo, IELTS Indicator/One Skill Retake, TOEFL Essentials/MyBest not accepted. Qualifying English-medium degree/home-language exemptions may apply. Unofficial scores for review; official after admission.

applicationFee.note: U.S. citizens/permanent residents free through October15. No general international waivers; special exceptions for CWRU students (including international), alumni, employees and U.S. armed-forces veterans; contact BSTP.

documents: School-issued unofficial transcripts from every college/university
Resume/CV with research, work and volunteer experiences/timeframes
Research experience descriptions and separate research/teaching experience statements
requirements.note: Biology, organic chemistry and math through calculus/statistics required; biochemistry/molecular biology recommended. No minimum GPA. International applicants typically need substantial post-bachelor’s research and often advanced degree; applications without post-undergraduate research unlikely considered. At least one recommendation from independent research mentor, letters signed/on letterhead. Do not contact faculty before decision. Rolling interview offers November–March; decisions generally1–2weeks after interview. Program sources disagree July/August1start; confirm.

funding.note: All matriculating BSTP students receive full tuition/fees, health insurance and $2000 moving allowance. Published stipend is2026–27; Fall2027 amount unconfirmed.
